rule.description: User Scoping and tracking relative position in hierarchy
rule.comment: The default policy assumes that you want to synchronize a subset of Notes with the Identity Vault. this rule marks events in the given containers for processing by adding the unmached-src-dn operational property. If you are using mirrored placement, the unmatched-src-dn is used later in the placement rule. If you change this rule, the placement rules must also be changed to reflect your policy.
